page.layout: One printed page, title block centred: four lines of title and imprint in the upper half. Faint show-through of the text from the reverse side appears below and at the left, not transcribed.
page.notes: Show-through from the reverse side of the leaf is not transcribed. The title page has no page number, running head, catchword or signature. Spelling normalised as the u/v and i/j rule requires: "SVLPICII" as SULPICII, "SEVERI" as SEVERI, "Ioh." as Joh. Ampersand kept as printed.
